description: List a channel's pinned messages, most recently pinned first. Returns { messages: [...], hasMore, nextBefore } with id, author, content, timestamp, pinnedAt, and the text of any embeds. Discord serves at most 50 pins per call, so when hasMore is true pass nextBefore back as `before` to fetch the next page. Requires the View Channel and Read Message History permissions; without Read Message History Discord returns an empty list, not an error. Read-only. Use discord_pin_message to change which messages are pinned.

before.description: Pagination cursor: an ISO timestamp compared against when a message was pinned, not when it was sent. Pass the previous response's nextBefore to fetch older pins.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread to list pins from.

name: discord_fetch_pinned_messages

moreFields.description: Count of fields left out past the first 10. Absent when none were.
